Overview

Delft is a city in South Holland with a population of 109,577. A quaint, historic city renowned for Delftware blue pottery, a top technical university, and a charming canal-lined city centre between The Hague and Rotterdam. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
